review_response_tasks.stem: Here is some ____ in a bowl. You can eat it with a spoon.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：复数grapes与is及it不一致。；B：复数sandwiches与is和it不一致。；C：rice不可数，和some、is、it及碗中食物一致。

review_response_tasks.stem: It's twelve. It's time ____ have lunch.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：for后此处不能直接接动词have。；B：time to have lunch为正确动词结构。；C：time at have不构成该结构。

review_response_tasks.stem: —How many ____ can you see? —Four tables in this room.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：many后复数，与回答Four tables直接一致。；B：many后不用单数。；C：回答是tables，不是windows。

review_response_tasks.stem: We have lunch ____ one ____ the afternoon ____ every Friday.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：钟点不用in，every Friday前不加at。；B：一般时段the afternoon不用on，every Friday前不加on。；C：at one、in the afternoon正确，every Friday前不加介词。

review_response_tasks.stem: Ben has new shoes. Look at ____ shoes! ____ brown.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：shoes为复数，不用It is。；B：Ben用his修饰，shoes复数用They are。；C：名词前用his，不用主格he。

review_response_tasks.stem: There is only milk, not juice, in the fridge. I can get ____, but not ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：与only milk及not juice一致。；B：将有和没有的饮料反过来了。；C：第一空与只有milk冲突。

review_response_tasks.stem: My mum works in this library. —____ your ____ here? —Yes, she is.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：mum单数不与Are一致。；B：brothers复数不与Is及she一致。；C：mum单数配Is，并由she回答。

review_response_tasks.stem: —Our class trip is cancelled. I feel sad. —____
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：没有新年语境，不回应坏消息。；B：称赞完成任务不回应行程取消的难过。；C：直接表达对取消行程的遗憾。
